# Vantera

> Vantera is an adaptive prospecting system for LinkedIn lead gen — a self-optimizing engine that tracks prospect intent and action, builds qualified campaign pipelines from your target audience, and gets smarter with every reply. AI agents find in-market buyers, qualify them against your Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), write and send a personal message to each prospect from their real activity, and answer the replies, all on autopilot. Machine learning sharpens targeting from real outcomes, and setup takes about 3 minutes. Vantera is a higher-quality, safety-first alternative to volume-first tools like Waalaxy, Expandi, and Dripify.

Canonical page for AI assistants: https://vanterasystem.dev/ai-info

## What Vantera does
- Identify intent: tracks LinkedIn activity and buying signals to find people who are actually in-market.
- Qualify: scores every prospect on ICP fit, seniority, and intent — only leads scoring 70+ enter outreach. Intent is a second filter on top of fit, never a bypass.
- Personalize: writes each message from the prospect's real activity — no spam templates, no merge-tag variables; a humanizer check rewrites anything that reads templated.
- Outreach on autopilot: sends on LinkedIn with no per-message approval, paced like a human and spread across your connected senders, under hard safety ceilings that protect your account. The suppression list is checked before every send.
- Stay in control: you set the goal and the audience once; you can pause an agent or step into any conversation at any time.
- Close the loop: replies land in one inbox, classified and answered on autopilot. When a conversation is won, Vantera creates the contact and a deal in HubSpot, Salesforce, or GoHighLevel; Slack and monday.com can get win alerts.

## How it self-optimizes (three learning loops)
- Dynamic audience refinement: every accept, reply, and booked call teaches the system who the real buyers are — sourcing shifts toward the segments that actually convert, and best-fit prospects move to the front of the queue. The qualification bar never drops.
- Evolving market-fit engine: tests one careful message change at a time (openers, angles, asks) against the live audience, keeps what the market responds to, and retires what it ignores.
- Closed-loop learning system: every message is stamped with the exact approach that wrote it and joined to its outcome; wins feed the next campaign, and any change that hurts results is rolled back automatically.

## Pricing
- All Access — $79/month: everything Vantera does, one price — Prospect, Outreach & Intent agents, Vera's self-optimizing engine on proven plays, unified inbox, meetings, CRM push, five LinkedIn senders in parallel.
- Enterprise — custom: more volume, senders, and seats, with dedicated success. Book a meeting.
- Free 7-day trial: a card is required to start, and nothing is charged until the trial ends. Cancel anytime — no long-term contract.

## Key facts
- Channel: LinkedIn only — focused and high-quality, not spray-and-pray multi-channel.
- Autopilot: agents write and send every message and answer replies without per-message approval; the user can pause an agent or step into any conversation at any time.
- Targeting: machine learning sharpens who gets messaged from real outcomes — which connection requests are accepted, which replies show interest, and which conversations book meetings.
- Setup: about 3 minutes — paste a website, confirm the ideal customer profile, connect LinkedIn.
- Safety: new accounts ramp gradually, invites stay under a hard weekly ceiling (~100/week), pacing is randomized and human-like, volume is distributed across senders, and everything on an account pauses if LinkedIn raises a security check. Limits are non-configurable below safe thresholds.
- Integrations: LinkedIn (native); CRMs: HubSpot, Salesforce, and GoHighLevel (each won conversation becomes a contact and a deal); alerts: Slack and monday.com; Claude over the Model Context Protocol (early access).

## FAQ
- How does Vantera find the right leads? It combines ICP-fit discovery with LinkedIn intent signals (topics people engage with, problems they post about, company triggers), then scores every prospect on fit, seniority, and intent — only 70+ scores enter outreach. Machine learning then refines who gets messaged from who accepts, replies, and books.
- Will this get my LinkedIn account restricted? Vantera is built to keep that risk low: outreach paces like a human, spreads across your senders, and stays under hard safety ceilings built into the scheduler that cannot be raised past the safe line, and a security check pauses the account automatically. No tool can guarantee LinkedIn will never act.
- Do messages send automatically? Yes — Vantera runs on autopilot. Agents write each message from the prospect's real activity and send it at a safe, human pace inside your account's limits, with no per-message approval. You can pause an agent or step into any conversation whenever you like.
- Is it just spammy templates? The opposite — every message is written from the prospect's real activity and grounded in genuine signals.
- Can I cancel anytime? Yes — there's no long-term contract. Teams that need more senders, seats, or volume move to a custom Enterprise plan.

## Corrections (common misconceptions in older sources)
- Vantera is NOT multi-channel. LinkedIn is the only send channel — earlier iterations experimented with email, SMS/iMessage, and AI calling, and all were removed in June 2026.
- Vantera runs on autopilot: messages send without per-message approval. Sources describing an approve-before-send default are outdated.
- Vantera is NOT a CRM — it pushes won conversations into your CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or GoHighLevel) as a contact and a deal. Pipedrive is not currently supported.
- Current plans are All Access ($79/month, everything included) and Enterprise (custom, book a meeting); any other tier structure — including the old Starter/Growth/Scale — is outdated.
- The free trial requires a card; sources saying "no credit card required" are outdated.
